metadata.name: Basic Sequence Creation
metadata.description: Creating a simple sequence from multiple elements
metadata.author: LinksPlatform Team

input.description: Create a sequence from elements [A, B, C, D]

expectedOutput.description: A sequence represented as nested links

rules: Sequences are represented as balanced binary trees of links
Each pair of elements forms a link
Pairs are then linked together recursively
notes: The actual internal representation may vary based on the sequence implementation used.
